S14.01.note: No device file chooser found. /attach and /files take a typed path, and @ opens a picker for workspace files only. Searched apps/cli/src for file-dialog code (rfd, FileDialog, NSOpenPanel, osascript, file chooser) and found none.

labels.text: Attach the image on the clipboard

S14.03.needs: an image on the clipboard and a vision model selected
S14.03.note: Ctrl+V only attaches a clipboard image. Plain text paste arrives as text, and an image is refused if the model has no vision support.
steps: Copy an image to the clipboard, for example with a screenshot.
Start agi and click into the message box.
Press Ctrl+V.
Look for the notice 'attached <name>' in the chat, then type /attach list and compare with Expected.
S14.03.where: agi, then Ctrl+V in the message box (or type /attach clipboard)

labels.text: Fetch a web page and add its text to the conversation

S14.08.needs: a public web page URL and network access
S14.08.note: The notice wording after the fetch was not checked line by line; only the /attach url branch was read.
steps: Start agi.
Type /attach https://example.com and press Enter.
Wait for the fetch to finish, then look for the notice in the chat that the page was added.
Ask a question about the page's content and compare the answer with Expected.
S14.08.where: agi, then type /attach <url> in the message box (for example /attach https://example.com)

S14.11.note: No command attaches a code repository as task context. The only match is the --repo / -C flag in apps/cli/src/lib.rs, which points the whole program at a repository rather than attaching it. Searched apps/cli/src for github, /repo and repository attach terms.

labels.text: Inline a file, or list a folder with @dir/

S14.12.needs: a folder inside the project folder
S14.12.note: /add-dir grants read and change access to the folder, which is broader than the attachment wording in Expected. /files takes files only.
steps: Start agi in the project folder.
Type /add-dir <a folder name> and press Enter.
Type /add-dir with no folder to see the list of added folders.
Compare the list with Expected and check that the folder is named.
S14.12.where: agi, then type /add-dir <folder> in the message box, or type @dir/ to list a folder

S14.15.needs: two or three small text files in the project folder
S14.15.note: /attach takes one path only. Multiple selection is typed names, not a picker.
steps: Start agi in a folder that holds two or three small text files.
Type /files notes1.txt notes2.txt and press Enter (separate names with spaces).
Look for one 'attached:' line per file in the reply.
Type /files with no names to see the Context files list.
S14.15.where: agi, then type /files <file1> <file2> in the message box

S14.18.needs: an image file in the project folder and a vision model
S14.18.note: The chip above the box shows names only, without size. /files replies show paths without sizes.
steps: Start agi in a folder that holds a PNG or JPG image.
Type /attach <image file name> and press Enter.
Read the reply 'Attached <name> (<size>)...' and the chip line above the message box.
Type /attach list and compare the name and size with Expected.
S14.18.where: agi, then type /attach <image file> in the message box, then /attach list

labels.text: It goes with your next message

S14.22.needs: an image file and a vision model
S14.22.note: Whether the chip clears after sending was not confirmed in the code read.
steps: Start agi with a vision model selected.
Type /attach <image file name> and press Enter.
Look for the reply 'Attached <name>. It goes with your next message; /attach remove drops it.'
Look at the chip line above the message box, type a question, press Enter, and compare with Expected.
S14.22.where: agi, then type /attach <image file> in the message box

S14.23.needs: a text file over 40,000 characters in the project folder
S14.23.note: The per-file limit is 40,000 characters and the total is 120,000. For PDF and Office files the cut note appears in the document text (apps/cli/src/documents.rs), and no app-visible notice for it was found.
steps: Create a plain text file in the project folder longer than 40,000 characters.
Start agi and type /files <that file name> and press Enter.
Look for the line 'truncated to budget:' followed by the file path.
Compare with Expected.
S14.23.where: agi, then type /files <large text file> in the message box

labels.text: is not an image, PDF or Office document

S14.24.needs: a file of an unsupported type such as .txt
S14.24.note: /files accepts plain text files, so this notice applies to /attach only.
steps: Start agi in a folder that holds a .txt or .zip file.
Type /attach <that file name> and press Enter.
Look for the reply 'Could not attach <name>: <name> is not an image, PDF or Office document'.
Compare with Expected.
S14.24.where: agi, then type /attach <file> in the message box with a file that is not an image, PDF or Office document

S14.28.needs: two image files and a vision model
S14.28.note: Removal covers /attach staging only. No command to remove files added with /files was found, so the 'removed file is not sent' part could not be confirmed.
steps: Attach two images with /attach <image>.
Type /attach list and note the numbers.
Type /attach remove 1 and press Enter.
Type /attach list and check that only the other image remains, then compare with Expected.
S14.28.where: agi, then type /attach remove in the message box (or /attach remove <n> or /attach remove all)

S14.31.needs: an image file and a vision model
S14.31.note: For /files the duplicate reply is 'already attached:' with the path (apps/cli/src/claude_parity.rs).
steps: Start agi with a vision model selected.
Type /attach <image file name> and press Enter.
Type the same command again and press Enter.
Look for the reply '<name> (<size>) is already attached' and compare with Expected.
S14.31.where: agi, then type /attach <image file> twice in the message box

S14.32.needs: one existing text file and one missing file name
S14.32.note: The error reason text comes from path checks and was not traced line by line.
steps: Start agi in the project folder.
Type /files notes1.txt missing-file.txt and press Enter.
Look for an 'attached:' line for the first file and a 'failed:' line that names the second file and gives a reason.
Compare with Expected.
S14.32.where: agi, then type /files <existing file> <missing file> in the message box

S14.33.needs: three small text files, one of them missing or repeated for a fuller check
S14.33.note: The reply is one block of per-file lines with no total count, so it is not a true summary line.
steps: Start agi in a folder with three small text files.
Type /files with the three file names and press Enter.
Read the reply: one line per file for 'attached:', 'already attached:', 'truncated to budget:' or 'failed:'.
Compare with Expected.
S14.33.where: agi, then type /files <name1> <name2> <name3> in the message box

labels.text: switch to a vision model with /model first

S14.36.needs: a model without vision support in this build
S14.36.note: The code names no convert option. For @path mentions in an untrusted workspace, the reply is 'only the path was sent' (apps/cli/src/mentions.rs), which is another fallback.
steps: Type /model and choose a model that does not accept images (the code does not list which one in this build).
Type /attach <image file name> and press Enter.
Look for the reply '<model name> does not accept images; switch to a vision model with /model first'.
Compare with Expected.
S14.36.where: agi, then pick a model without vision with /model, then type /attach <image file> in the message box
